summary.headline: Planetary Relations and Malefic Effects
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Mars and the Sun in relation to Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, and themselves, covering illness, conflict, wealth, glory, childbirth, exile, marriage, lawsuits, and disturbances.
